# MatrixMindset

> MatrixMindset is a 365-day consistency engine for JEE, NEET, and Foundation aspirants. Track deep-focus sessions, milestones, and study progress against AI-parsed syllabus roadmaps.

## Pages

- [Sign In](/auth): Sign in or create a MatrixMindset account.
- [Reset Password](/reset-password): Reset your account password.

## Optional

- [Dashboard](/): Personal deep-work dashboard (requires sign-in).
- [Smart Calendar](/calendar): Timeline of syllabus milestones (requires sign-in).
- [Study Timer](/timer): Focus timer with Zen soundscapes (requires sign-in).
- [365 Challenge](/365): 365-day consistency tracker (requires sign-in).
- [Mastery Tracks](/courses): Course and grade management (requires sign-in).
